models.name: Aqara FP300
models.notes: 24 distance bands of 0.25 m, rated 120° / 6 m.

models.name: Aqara FP1E
models.notes: Zigbee2MQTT exposes presence, movement, target_distance and detection_range.

models.name: Aqara FP310
models.notes: Same distance and band controls as the FP300. China-market model; Zigbee2MQTT has an open bug where it stops responding.

models.name: Aqara FP1
models.notes: Up to 10 regions on a 4×7 grid. Discontinued.

models.name: Aqara P1 motion sensor
models.notes: Occupancy, sensitivity and detection_interval (2–65535 s); about 170° / 7 m. Set detection_interval to its minimum during a test.

models.name: Aqara FP400
models.notes: Live X/Y positions through add-on Zigbee2MQTT converters. Plain Matter reports a single occupancy only. Several FP400 map cards already exist; Blip's version may sit alongside them.

models.name: Aqara FP2
models.reason: Home Assistant gets no position data from it.

integration_work.name: ZHA support
integration_work.notes: HA 2026.11's built-in FP300 quirk exposes only presence, PIR and battery, with an open bug where they never update.

integration_work.name: Thread/Matter support
integration_work.notes: Whether distance and bands are available over Matter isn't confirmed.
